background: A schedule may only raise a prompt. It never contacts a service on its own; check, download and install each wait for a fresh, direct user approval naming the service, endpoint, operation and data.

admission.signature: Ed25519 (below the post-quantum floor; ML-DSA-65 verifier is open work)
admission.digest: SHA-256 equals the manifest digest before any write
admission.rollback: UPDATE.BIN keeps the previous BOOTX64.EFI chain; versions must rise (>= 1)

appUpdates: An installed app updates only to a catalog entry whose CID digest and signature verify; the old version stays until the new one is admitted.
